exercises.title: Slide check: React-Bootstrap components
exercises.problemHtml:
Eight questions on using Bootstrap through React components.

Tip: read every option before choosing — the wrong options are real mistakes students make in the FE exam.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All questions must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Tám câu về cách dùng Bootstrap qua component React.

Mẹo: đọc hết các lựa chọn rồi mới chọn — các phương án sai đều là lỗi thật sinh viên hay mắc trong đề FE.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

solutionCodeJson.name: answers.md
solutionCodeJson.code:
# Slide check: React-Bootstrap components — answer key

1. Correct import of a Button?
   Answer: b) import { Button } from 'react-bootstrap'
   Named import from react-bootstrap (or the per-component path react-bootstrap/Button). / Import có tên từ react-bootstrap (hoặc đường dẫn riêng react-bootstrap/Button).

2. <Button variant="outline-success" size="lg"> produces…
   Answer: a) btn btn-outline-success btn-lg
   variant ⇒ btn-{variant}, size ⇒ btn-{size}. / variant ⇒ btn-{variant}, size ⇒ btn-{size}.

3. How do you open a React-Bootstrap Modal?
   Answer: b) Set a state to true and pass it as show
   Modals are controlled: show={isOpen} and onHide={() => setOpen(false)}. / Modal là controlled: show={isOpen} và onHide={() => setOpen(false)}.

4. Which subcomponents belong to Card? (choose all)
   Answer: a) Card.Body + b) Card.Title + d) Card.Img
   Card has Body, Title, Subtitle, Text, Img, Header, Footer, Link — no Row. / Card có Body, Title, Subtitle, Text, Img, Header, Footer, Link — không có Row.

5. <Row xs={1} md={3}> means…
   Answer: b) 1 column per row on phones, 3 per row from md
   Numeric props on Row become row-cols-* classes. / Prop số trên Row thành class row-cols-*.

6. What does the as prop do?
   Answer: b) Changes the rendered HTML element/component while keeping the styles
   e.g. <Nav.Link as={NavLink} to="/"> renders a router link with Bootstrap styles. / vd vẽ link của router với giao diện Bootstrap.

7. Form validation styles appear when…
   Answer: a) You add validated to Form (after submit) or isInvalid to a control
   validated adds .was-validated (browser rules); isInvalid/isValid are for your own rules. / validated thêm .was-validated (luật trình duyệt); isInvalid/isValid dành cho luật của bạn.

8. Why prefer Navbar.Collapse + Navbar.Toggle over a plain list of links?
   Answer: b) They collapse the menu into a hamburger on small screens
   With expand="lg", below lg the links hide behind the toggle button. / Với expand="lg", dưới lg các link ẩn sau nút ☰.
